method: The actual ScansTabView and SceneKit ScanViewer3D running in an iPhone simulator. A clearly named Sample room mesh fixture is loaded into the app’s normal mesh store. This is a sample 3D mesh, not a scan made with LiDAR. Live AR mapping, navigation, and LiDAR capture require a physical compatible device.
